
3.wifi指令打开（打开wifi和服务器后会变卡）

dbus-send --system --print-reply --dest=rockchip.dbserver / rockchip.dbserver.net.Cmd \string:"{ \"table\": \"NetworkPower\",\"key\": {\"sType\": \"wifi\"}, \"data\": {\"iPower\": 1}, \"cmd\": \"Update\" }"


//打开wpa_supplicant进程（注意wpa_supplicant.conf的位置）
wpa_supplicant -B -i wlan0 -c /data/cfg/wpa_supplicant.conf
//当蓝牙没有打开是rfkill0   f2为rfkill0  f8位rfkill1
echo 1 > /sys/class/rfkill/rfkill0/state
//打开wifi
ifconfig wlan0 up
//扫描附近的wifi
wpa_cli -i wlan0 -p /var/run/wpa_supplicant scan
//打印扫描出的wifi
wpa_cli -i wlan0 -p /var/run/wpa_supplicant scan_results(wifi名称为/x编码)
echo -e `wpa_cli -i wlan0 -p /var/run/wpa_supplicant scan_result`(wifi名称为中文)

//连接指定wifi
wifi_start.sh TianZe 86337898
//设置自动获取ip
udhcpc -i wlan0  
//查看wifi连接信息
wpa_cli -i wlan0 -p /var/run/wpa_supplicant status

出现
Line 7: Invalid passphrase length 1 (expected: 8..63) '9"'.
Line 7: failed to parse psk '"9"'.
Line 9: failed to parse network block.
Failed to read or parse configuration '/data/cfg/wpa_supplicant.conf'.
这种问题 需要修改/data/cfg/wpa_supplicant.conf文件
//关闭wifi
ifconfig wlan0 down
killall wpa_supplicant
